name: GEONATIONS | Java + Bedrock SMP
description:
GeoNations is a nations SMP where the map is the politics.

Claim land, found a nation, and go to war over it. Every chunk out there is territory someone can own, tax, defend or take off you.

Claim and build. Your first chunk is $250 and each one after costs 7% more. Use a free Camp block first for a 9 chunk trial.

Found a nation. Grow a claim to Town level and you can found one, set your own tax rate, and take in other players' lands as members.

Declare war. Wars are declared from your land. You can place bounties on players head.

A player driven economy. Chest shops, an auction house, player warps, vaults and there are p2p trading.

Real Life Seasons. There are live temperatures and seasons, like spring and winter. Make sure you equip proper gear for the cold or freeze.

Java and Bedrock together. Full crossplay. Phone, console and PC all in the same server. Same wars, Same players.

Live Geo Political Map. Watch the borders move on the live world map at map.geonations.org.

There is NO Pay To Win.

Java: geonations.org  ·  Bedrock: geonations.org port 19132
